statement: 复杂 UI 请求通常同时包含布局、控制层级、作用域、绑定、发现等多个语义。Foundry 的检索层应返回一组有证据的 Pattern，并用显式 Composition Recipe/Relation 描述它们能否组合、各自角色、实现与证据缺口。

scope.notes: Conservative Claim model of Experimental catalog record OPS.UIGS.COMPOSABLE_PATTERN_PLANNING; support threshold intentionally exceeds current independent evidence by one group.

review.rationale: Evidence-insufficient Experimental record modeled without promotion; additional independent evidence is required by policy.
